instruction.text: Vervollständige den Dialog mithilfe der Bilder.

atoms.b: Hello Elena. My family wants to go to the ((++USA Canada)) on our next holidays, but we are not sure where to go yet. Since you are from there, can you recommend a place?

Sure. People going to the USA on their holidays can end up having completely different holidays, because the ((++country city)) is huge and has different ((++regions presidents)). Do you know what you would like to do?

Okay then. In the USA you can go on a ((++city_trip hiking_trip beach_trip ski_trip)), since there are so many big cities. The biggest cities in the US are ((++New_York_City,_L.A._and_Chicago London,_Birmingham_and_Manchester)).
That sounds good, but we went to a city on our last holiday. We're thinking about going to a more ((++rural_area rude_area)) this time.

In the US you could also go on a ((city_trip hiking_trip ++beach_trip ski_trip)) and enjoy various water sports. The first beach that comes to mind is probably Waikiki Beach in ((++Hawaii Bali)). There is also South Beach in Miami, Surfrider Beach in Malibu and many more.
I'm not into ((++hot cold)) weather. I prefer cold conditions.

If you don't like warm weather, but still want to be active, you could go on a ((city_trip hiking_trip beach_trip ++ski_trip)). The best state for skiing and snowboarding is ((++Colorado Hawaii)). There are many famous ski areas and resorts, like Aspen, Vail, Breckenridge and Telluride.
What else can you do in the USA?

You could go on a ((city_trip ++hiking_trip beach_trip ski_trip)) too. There are breathtaking national parks in the USA. With nine national parks, California has got the most. One of them is ((++Yosemite_National_Park Harz_National_Park)).
That sounds ((++great boring)). We'll definitely consider Yosemite National Park.

I can recommend the heartland as well, which is the area between the East and West Coast of the USA. In contrast to the urban areas of the Coasts, the heartland is more rural and has many ((++small_towns big_cities)). I also want to mention that there are lots of horse ((++farms lakes)), for example in Kentucky. I know how much your younger brother loves horses.
I will keep that in ((++mind hands)). Thank you for your help!
You're welcome! Let me know where you're going when you've made up your mind.
